svg.title: Riju records route provenance while Cecil connects a battery audio data coupler.
svg.desc: Riju matches physical patch cords to separate source entries while Babul-da calls out landmarks. Cecil links a digital data lead to a two-cup audio coupler and analogue jack, making the conversion between systems visible.
svg.text: Page 50, panel 2 · Side view along a row of manual patch connections

text.tspan: through human route knowledge, then the coupler
encodes the emergency data over a physical voice
